name: Rover Racer
author: Bwavo
description:
Build, Drive, Survive!
Rover Racer takes you to the surface of Mars where you get to build a rover of your very own using LEGO parts. 
Post your best times, let's see who's the fastest!
Use the Import and Export tools to share your vehicles! Bonus points to the most creative ones, leave your vehicle codes in the comments!
